title: Make as the developer interface; remove the workbench console script

settled_decisions.D1: Make is the single developer interface for workbench/. Base Makefile gains: setup, ui-setup, ui-build, gen-api, ui-test, build (depends on ui-build), up, down, serve, test, migrate, lint, format, logs, health, triage, clean.
settled_decisions.D2: Remove the `workbench` console script: delete src/workbench/cli.py and [project.scripts]. serve -> thin launcher src/workbench/__main__.py (python -m workbench) that loads config and runs uvicorn with config.server.host/port/debug (preserves the loopback default from T274646800).
settled_decisions.D3: Terminal triage kept: move triage() to scripts/triage.py (argparse --server/--token), invoked by `make triage`. Update console.py message and ADR 0001 reference.
settled_decisions.D4: make build builds the UI: add ui-build target; build depends on it; fix base Dockerfile COPY /app/ui-dist -> /app/ui/dist so the image serves /ui. Align scripts/workbench-start.sh to python -m workbench (loopback).
settled_decisions.D5: Both repos in lockstep: workbench-meta Makefile gains a host ui-build step before `make up` (it volume-mounts ui/dist); its override command switches to `python -m workbench` so it honors config (loopback boundary) + WORKBENCH_CONFIG_OVERRIDE.
settled_decisions.D6: lint/format targets add `ruff` to dev-deps (the one additive tool choice; modern default).
settled_decisions.D7: Commit each artifact as it passes, on branch feat/dashboard-followups.

key_findings: `workbench serve` has NO runtime callers (entrypoint.sh + meta override both run uvicorn directly); only docs reference it.
`workbench triage` IS used: base Makefile triage target + console.py message + ADR 0001.
Latent bug: base Dockerfile copies UI to /app/ui-dist but main.py mounts /app/ui/dist -> base image 404s /ui.
Meta mounts host-built ui/dist as a volume + sets WORKBENCH_CONFIG_OVERRIDE env -> override survives script removal; but ui/dist must be host-built before `make up`.
Extra launch paths binding host: scripts/workbench-start.sh (--host 0.0.0.0), meta override command (--host ::).
